{{short description|Chinese geologist and geophysicist}}
{{family name hatnote|[[Ma (surname)|Ma]]|lang=Chinese}}

'''Ma Jin''' ({{zh|s=马瑾}}; 27 November 1934 – 12 August 2018) was a Chinese [[geophysicist]] and [[structural geologist]]. She was a senior research fellow at the Institute of Geology of the [[China Earthquake Administration]], and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
Ma was born on 27 November 1934 in [[Rugao]], [[Jiangsu]], Republic of China.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/o/2018-08-13/doc-ihhqtawx6364240.shtml|title=著名构造物理与构造地质学家马瑾院士逝世|date=2018-08-13|website=Sina|access-date=2019-03-03}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.eq-igl.ac.cn/Geology/TeamContent.aspx?id=31|title=Ma Jin|website=China Earthquake Administration|access-date=2019-03-02}}</ref> She studied at the [[Beijing Institute of Geology]] from 1952 to 1956. After graduation, she entered the Institute of Geology of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS) to study [[structural geology]] under [[Zhang Wenyou]] ({{lang|zh-Hans|张文佑}}). In 1958, she went to the [[Soviet Union]] to study at the Institute of Tectonophysics, [[USSR Academy of Sciences]], and earned an associate doctor degree (Ph.D. equivalent) in 1962.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://en.igl.earthquake.cn/wwwroot/c_000000020001/d_0088.html|title=Ma Jin|website=China Earthquake Administration|access-date=2019-03-03}}</ref>

After returning to China in 1962, she worked as an assistant researcher at the Institute of Geology of CAS. In 1978, she was transferred to the Institute of Geology of the [[China Earthquake Administration]] and promoted to associate research fellow. She became senior research fellow in 1981, and later served as Director of the institute's academic committee. She was a visiting scholar at the [[United States Geological Survey]] in 1983.<ref name=":1" />

Ma made significant contributions in [[tectonophysics]], specifically the mechanisms of tectonic deformation and its relations to [[seismic activity]].<ref name=":1" /> She published over 200 scientific papers and several [[monographs]], and won more than 10 national and ministerial awards.<ref name=":0" /> She was elected an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1997.<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":1" />

Ma died in Beijing on 12 August 2018, at the age of 83.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2018/8/416458.shtm|title=我国著名构造物理与构造地质学家马瑾院士逝世|date=2018-08-12|website=Sciencenet.cn|access-date=2019-03-03}}</ref>
